title: Wayne S NDE 4920
content: I was standing in the kitchen of my home. My wife asked me a question and I tried to answer, my mouth opened but I couldn't speak. The next thing I knew, I was looking at myself collapsing to the floor from what appeared to be the inside of a large, dark tube. Everything in front of me became dark and I lost sight of myself. Then a bright white light appeared behind me. I was not able to turn around and look into the light. Instead, the light started slowly enveloping me on either side, almost like fingers of light. I still didn't turn around to face it. Then everything went black. I had a brief moment when I opened my eyes enough to see the flashing lights of an emergency vehicle. The next thing I remember is waking up in the intensive care unit of a hospital connected to tubes and IVs. This wasn't quite the end. Once I was out of the hospital and mobile again, I would get strange feelings now and then. I could feel them coming on. My mouth would water and taste metallic. I would become weak and begin to sweat. Then I would become aware of a tunnel - I couldn't see it, but I knew it was there and voices would emanate from it. Then it would be gone. A couple of times, I thought I recognized a voice or a word. I can't remember what was said.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He reported seeing himself collapse to the floor "from what appeared to be the inside of a large, dark tube."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sudden inability to speak followed by collapse at home; later hospitalized in ICU (specific medical diagnosis not stated).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He later reported recurring episodes after discharge: metallic taste, sweating/weakness, then awareness of a tunnel and voices emanating from it.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/tube darkness, then bright light behind him that enveloped him, then blackness; later brief awareness of emergency vehicle lights; later waking in ICU.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Post-hospital episodes included repeated awareness of a tunnel and voices emanating from it.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He could not turn around to look at the bright white light; it "slowly enveloping me on either side, almost like fingers of light." After hospital discharge, he reported recurrent episodes with a metallic taste, sweating/weakness, and awareness of a tunnel with voices emanating from it.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was looking at myself collapsing to the floor from what appeared to be the inside of a large, dark tube.” “Then a bright white light appeared behind me. I was not able to turn around and look into the light.” “the light started slowly enveloping me on either side, almost like fingers of light.” “Then I would become aware of a tunnel - I couldn't see it, but I knew it was there and voices would emanate from it.”
